title: Professional Certificate Course in Realizing E-Business Strategy and Implementation
description: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of E-commerce Marketing and strategies with the help of case studies.
longDescription: Understand E-commerce Marketing and strategies with the help of case studies Grow Ecommerce by understanding the strategies and barriers to growth. Understand Competitive Advantage, Michael Porter & Sustainable Competitive Advantage. Understand and measure the success of a strategy with the help of cost-benefit analysis and ROI calculation techniques. Understand the process and Requirements of Starting an Online Business and measuring its impact. With the aid of case studies, this course seeks to give students a thorough understanding of E-commerce Marketing and tactics. Students who successfully complete this course will be able to comprehend the growth methods and constraints faced by e-commerce enterprises and possess the competencies required to establish, expand, and maintain a profitable online enterprise.
courseDetails: This course aims to give students a comprehensive understanding of E-commerce Marketing and strategies via the use of case studies. By successfully completing this course, students will be able to appreciate the growth strategies and limitations faced by e-commerce businesses and will have the skills necessary to start, manage, and sustain a successful online business.
